latest_release.name: v2.0.5
latest_release.body:
All 81 npm cohort packages are available as version 2.0.5 on `latest`. The source is `c094a549fee09f6e06911b8486b9789b536401aa` from `develop`.

Use exact versions to install this release:

```sh
npm install @elizaos/core@2.0.5
npm install @elizaos/agent@2.0.5
```

The public tarball bytes, sizes, package names, versions, source IDs and publisher records matched the immutable release plan for all 81 packages. The attached plan is the original plan. The attached validation record gives the observation times, package hashes and evidence hashes.

This GitHub record uses a manual metadata recovery lane. Canonical workflow run 43049531373, attempt 6, failed after npm publication and `latest` promotion. npm rejected a DELETE request for the temporary candidate alias with HTTP 403. At the last byte-audit observation, all 81 candidate aliases still pointed to 2.0.5. This recovery leaves npm and those aliases untouched. The canonical workflow and transaction state remain failed or incomplete. This record does not claim that all checks passed.

The public consumer check passed Core install, dependency tree and compiled import. Agent install and CLI version also passed. The Agent dependency tree returned exit code 1: React 19.3.1 failed a peer range, and 15 packages were reported as extraneous. No provider calls, full Agent startup, native capabilities or device acceptance were checked.

Desktop publication was disabled. The Snap Store, Microsoft Store, and Google Play and Apple App Store jobs were skipped. This is an npm release; this metadata recovery does not publish desktop installers or store builds.

The complete [GitHub-generated repository change list](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/v2.0.5/full-changelog.md) is attached. GitHub generated it at 2026-11-11 22:12:20 UTC and selected `pr-evidence-14` as the comparison base for `v2.0.5`. The [full comparison](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/compare/pr-evidence-14...v2.0.5) preserves that scope. Package and runtime qualification evidence is in `package-validation.json`.
